key_concepts: Sound travels through air and through solid materials like string.
Sound speed differs between air and string.
Sound energy from a speaker causes air molecules to vibrate.
Vibrating air molecules can move lightweight objects.
Plucking with more force increases loudness.
Loudness is related to amplitude of vibration.
Tension of a rubber band affects pitch.
Pitch is the highness or lowness of sound and is related to vibration frequency.
